;===============================================================
;== ANCILLARY TRIGGERS START HERE ==============================
;===============================================================
;===============================================================
;Roman Provincial Government Triggers
;===============================================================
;IMPORTANT: Needs to be at the start of the trigger section. DO NOT MOVE IT!

Trigger acquire_Governor_of_Sicily_Syrakousai
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType seleucid
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Syrakousai
          and I_SettlementOwner Messana = seleucid
          and I_SettlementOwner Lilibeo = seleucid
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and SettlementBuildingExists < govparthian
          and Attribute Electability < 11
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists Governor_of_Sicily
          and Trait FamilyMember > 0

    AcquireAncillary Governor_of_Sicily  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger acquire_Governor_of_Sicily_Messana
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType seleucid
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Messana
          and I_SettlementOwner Syracuse = seleucid
          and I_SettlementOwner Lilibeo = seleucid
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and SettlementBuildingExists < govparthian
          and Attribute Electability < 11
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists Governor_of_Sicily
          and Trait FamilyMember > 0

    AcquireAncillary Governor_of_Sicily  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

;;------------------------------------------

;------------------------------------------
Trigger acquire_Governor_of_Gallia_Cisalpina_Bononia
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType seleucid
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Bononia
          and I_SettlementOwner Patavium = seleucid
          and I_SettlementOwner Segesta = seleucid
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and SettlementBuildingExists < govparthian
          and Attribute Electability < 11
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists Governor_of_Gallia_Cisalpina
          and Trait FamilyMember > 0

    AcquireAncillary Governor_of_Gallia_Cisalpina  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------

;===============================================================
;Seleukid Satrapal Government Triggers
;===============================================================
;------------------------------------------
Trigger acquire_satrapy_baktria_a
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType romans_julii
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Baktra
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and Attribute SenateStanding < 11
          and Trait NoMoreAncillaries < 1
          and Trait Loyalty > 3
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists satrapy_of_baktria
          and RandomPercent > 60

    AcquireAncillary satrapy_of_baktria  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger acquire_satrapy_baktria_b
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType romans_julii
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Baktra
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and Attribute SenateStanding < 11 
          and Trait NoMoreAncillaries < 1
          and Trait RoyalFriend > 0
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists satrapy_of_baktria
          and RandomPercent > 70

    AcquireAncillary satrapy_of_baktria  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

;------------------------------------------
Trigger acquire_satrapy_baktria_c
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    Condition FactionType romans_julii
          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral
          and SettlementName Baktra
          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and Attribute SenateStanding < 11 
          and Trait NoMoreAncillaries < 1
          and Attribute Influence > 4
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists satrapy_of_baktria
          and RandomPercent > 90

    AcquireAncillary satrapy_of_baktria  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

          and EndedInSettlement
          and RemainingMPPercentage = 100
          and IsGeneral

          and SettlementBuildingExists > gov4
          and Attribute SenateStanding < 11 
          and Trait NoMoreAncillaries < 1
          and Attribute Influence > 4
          and not FactionwideAncillaryExists satrapy_of_parthaya
          and RandomPercent > 90

    AcquireAncillary satrapy_of_parthaya  Chance  100
    Affects NumAncillariesAcquired  1  Chance  100

Trigger Hayasdan_PanCaucasusReform_Complete
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    
    Condition Trait Arkah = 1
          and Trait PanCaucasusEmpire < 1
          and FactionType romans_scipii
          and WorldwideAncillaryExists KingOfKingsAncillary

    Affects PanCaucasusEmpire  1  Chance  100
    Affects Arkah  1  Chance  100
    
;------------------------------------------
Trigger Hayasdan_OrontidReform_Complete
    WhenToTest CharacterTurnEnd
    
    Condition Trait Arkah = 2
          and Trait PanCaucasusEmpire = 1
          and FactionType romans_scipii
          and WorldwideAncillaryExists ShahanshahAncillary

    Affects PanCaucasusEmpire  1  Chance  100
    Affects Arkah  1  Chance  100

          and not AgentType = diplomat
          and not AgentType = admiral 
          and not CultureType barbarian 
          and not CultureType nomad 
          and not CultureType eastern

    AcquireAncillary courtesan chance  15
